name: Lockup reveal
one_line: A mark and name assemble into a final lockup arrangement that holds as the end card
summary: The parts of a lockup arrive separately, such as the mark, the name and a supporting line, and settle into one fixed arrangement that then stays still. It gives a piece a signed-off ending and a calm, assured close. A reveal that keeps moving or leaves the hold too short wastes the moment it exists to deliver.

routes.one_line: Lockup parts as SVG groups entering on an Anime.js timeline, seeked per frame

steps.does: Author the lockup as vector groups with stable ids, one per part
Bring each group in on its own onset and settle them into place
Seek, settle and screenshot each frame of the page

limits: SVG evidence is one static file rasterised by resvg; no animated or browser-rendered SVG
Anime.js evidence is transforms, stroke draw and stagger; springs and morphs are untested
No fixture assembles a lockup; fonts-to-paths for the name is a guide step, not exercised

routes.one_line: Lockup parts as DOM or SVG elements animated with the Web Animations API, seeked per frame

steps.does: Give each lockup part its own animation with an offset onset
Seek, settle and screenshot each frame of the page

limits: Evidence covers transform, stroke draw and staggered opacity; clip, blur and filter reveals are untested
Overshoot must be built from eased keyframes; springs are outside the tool's scope

source: references/pacing-editor §8, references/motion-director §3.3, references/typography §9c; tool records as of 2026-11-20
